    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Barge
    Represents a barge in the Battleship game.
    Caravel
    Represents a Caravel ship in the Battleship game.
    Carrack
    Represents a Carrack ship in the Battleship game.
    Compass
    Represents the possible compass directions used by ships.
    Fleet
    Represents a fleet of ships in the Battleship game.
    Frigate
    Represents a frigate that occupies four positions on the board.
    Galleon
    Represents a galleon that occupies five positions on the board.
    Game
    Manages a Battleship game by recording shots and tracking their results against a fleet.
    IFleet
    Defines the operations for managing a fleet of ships.
    IGame
    Defines the operations for managing a Battleship game and retrieving its current status.
    IPosition
    Contrato para uma posição (célula) na grelha do jogo Discoveries Battleship Game.
    IShip
    Contrato para um navio no jogo Discoveries Battleship Game.
    Position
    Implementação de IPosition: uma célula da grelha do jogo Discoveries Battleship Game.
    Ship
    Classe base abstrata para todos os navios do jogo Discoveries Battleship Game.
    Tasks
    Tarefas de teste em linha de comandos para o jogo Discoveries Battleship Game.
